title: Autumn 1 synoptic assessment
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: Name the search algorithm needing sorted input.
Choose the model answer: Which structure processes items FIFO?
Choose the model answer: Simplify A ∧ 1.
